subtitle: Lesson 16 · Working in AWS

code:
CLI:
aws s3 cp file.csv s3://my-bucket/raw/

boto3 (Python SDK):
s3_client.upload_file(
  "file.csv", "my-bucket", "raw/file.csv"
)
caption: Same API call underneath — the SDK is for code, not a terminal.

code:
# Client: low-level, maps 1:1 onto the API
s3_client = boto3.client("s3")
s3_client.put_object(Bucket=..., Key=..., Body=...)

# Resource: higher-level, object-oriented
s3_resource = boto3.resource("s3")
s3_resource.Bucket("my-bucket").put_object(...)
caption: Client exists for every service; resource covers only a subset.

subtitle: CLI and SDK concepts, put to work on something real.
